SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET AS PLANG , KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO , KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'CHSG' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, A.PLANT, ISNULL(A.QUOTATION_NO,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, ISNULL(A.QUOTATION_SEQ,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, ISNULL(A.REVISION_NO,' ') AS REVISION, ISNULL(A.STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, ISNULL(A.ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(A.DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(A.SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(A.UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, ISNULL(A.MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, ISNULL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_TELNO,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, ISNULL(A.REQ_USER_MAIL,' ') AS REQ_USER_MAIL, ISNULL(A.CLOSE_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, ISNULL(A.CLOSE_TIME,' ') AS CLOSE_TIME, ISNULL(A.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(A.REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM V_KEP_RE A WHERE PLANT = '$PLANG$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_NO_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', KEY_6 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANG$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$'
